source.publisher: Fermanagh Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names, divisions and party labels read on the page image of the Fermanagh Times nominations report of 8 May 1930

note: Nomination-day report for the nineteen divisions of Irvinestown rural district, one member each. There was no contest; the new council was returned with eight Nationalists (three of them co-opted) and eleven Unionists. The Ederney nomination, illegible in the OCR, was read on the page image (7 Nov 2026 (meetings-fermanagh1930)): Bernard Maguire (Nat.). The round is filed on the rural districts' polling day in early June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
